Ruijie RG-EW3200GX PRO 3200Mbps Gigabit WiFi 6 Router


Experience ultra-fast and reliable internet connectivity with the Ruijie RG-EW3200GX PRO, a high-performance WiFi 6 router designed to meet the demands of modern homes and small offices. Boasting a blazing speed of up to 3200Mbps, this router ensures seamless streaming, gaming, and multiple device connectivity with minimal latency.


Key Features & Technical Specifications:

  • WiFi 6 (802.11ax) Technology: Supports the latest WiFi 6 standard offering higher throughput, improved network efficiency, and better performance in crowded environments.
  • Maximum Speed: Up to 3200Mbps combined wireless speed (2402Mbps on 5GHz + 800Mbps on 2.4GHz bands).
  • Dual-Band Connectivity: Operates on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands for flexible and stable connections across devices.
  • Gigabit Ethernet Ports: Equipped with multiple gigabit LAN ports and 1 WAN port to ensure high-speed wired connectivity.
  • OFDMA & MU-MIMO Support: Enables simultaneous communication with multiple devices, reducing latency and improving overall network efficiency.
  • Beamforming Technology: Focuses WiFi signals directly to connected devices for stronger and more reliable connections.
  • Advanced Security: Supports WPA3 encryption for enhanced wireless security and network protection.
  • Easy Management: User-friendly web interface and mobile app support for easy setup, monitoring, and management of your network.
  • Coverage: Optimized antenna design ensures wide-area wireless coverage ideal for medium to large homes or offices.
